title: Nijuuei

guide_target.label: 二重影（2000年オリジナルPC版）

routes.title: 桔梗ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 桔梗 END by the directly inspected SagaoZ walkthrough. The same walkthrough also documents a 桔梗 BAD END detour near the final-day heroine choice. This route is the source walkthrough's first full playthrough and establishes shared save points used to shorten later heroine clears.

routes.title: 命ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 命 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from an earlier shared save and also documents 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, 命 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END detours. These are ending detours within the overall 命-oriented walkthrough path, not separate main heroine routes.

routes.title: 楓玲ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 楓玲 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from a save created during the 命 path and documents a 楓玲 BAD END before the main 楓玲 END. The save reuse is a guide optimization rather than a confirmed hard in-game unlock prerequisite.

sources.title: 二重影 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Set A. Directly inspected complete Japanese walkthrough for ケロQ 二重影, explicitly marked 確認バージョン『修正なし』 and 状況『完了（CG・回想100%）』. It covers 桔梗・命・楓玲, every movement/choice sequence, timed choices, shared saves, and the documented main/bad/alternate endings.

sources.title: ゲーム攻略＿二重影 (Destiny-Tiar / Infoseek mirror)
sources.notes: Independent Set-B candidate discovered in Japanese web search. Indexed content independently states that the three攻略 heroines are 楓玲・命・桔梗, that they share progress through day 9, that 桔梗 branches on day 9 and 楓玲/命 on day 11, and that timed-choice failures cause immediate bad ends. Search-indexed excerpts also expose route-ending instructions. However, direct page inspection currently times out, so under the repository's source-inspection rule this does NOT yet count as accepted Set B.

sources.title: PCゲーム攻略/は行/ふ/二重影 - ゲーム攻略まとめwiki
sources.notes: Supplementary only. Directly inspectable and complete-looking, but it explicitly attributes its save data/source basis to SAGAOZ and reproduces the SagaoZ walkthrough structure/text. It is therefore derivative and cannot count as an independent Set B.

sources.title: 二重影日文攻略 - 2DFan
sources.notes: Supplementary only. Directly inspectable Japanese-text copy whose route sequence is effectively verbatim SagaoZ material. It is not independent enough to satisfy Set B.

sources.title: 二重影 - KeroQ official product page
sources.notes: Official target/provenance reference for the original PC product. The page identifies 二重影 as a discontinued KeroQ product. Used to anchor guide_target, not as a walkthrough verification set.

sources.title: ケロQ＆枕 Official site - 二重影 support/update page
sources.notes: Official PC support reference. Documents 二重影 executable/update files and Windows-specific support instructions, corroborating the original Windows PC target. Not a walkthrough source.

disagreements: RESEARCH GATE BLOCKER: Set A is directly inspected and complete, but an independent directly inspectable Set B has not yet passed the repository gate. The strongest independent candidate is the old Destiny-Tiar/Infoseek walkthrough mirrored at ifs.nog.cc; search indexing exposes substantive independent route structure, but direct fetches time out. The directly accessible AtWiki and 2DFan pages are derivatives/copies of SagaoZ and therefore cannot be used as independent verification. Per AGENTS.md / guide-author rules, route JSON generation must stop here until an independent Japanese Set B can be directly inspected. TARGET NOTE: this guide is scoped to KeroQ's original 2000 Windows PC product, not the 2002 Dreamcast/PlayStation ports. Contemporary listings distinguish 初回版 and 通常版 packaging; no route-content difference between those PC packages was directly verified in this pass, so the target is intentionally the original PC product family rather than a console port.
